name: Bad Salzuflen (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and blue in the proportions 1:2:1, charged towards the hoist with the city arms of Bad Salzuflen (salt-works pumps and a star on blue).
history: Flag and banner of the city are blue-white-blue in the ratio 1:2:1, the flag striped horizontally with the arms shifted towards the hoist.

features.role: Bad Salzuflen arms — salt-works pumps and star on blue
